question: Which devotees are deemed most united in yoga?
premises: Arjuna asks about constantly united devotees.
He contrasts worship of the Lord with worship of the unmanifest.
The question seeks a distinction among devotees.
inference: The verse frames a comparative question about devotees and their objects of worship.
uncertainties: The fused compound kevalamātmamātra-mupāsate is treated as one token.
plain_english: Arjuna asks which devotees are most accomplished in yoga, those who worship the Lord or those who worship the unmanifest.
